note: Deterministic concept-distribution markers for the contrastive / non-contrastive SSL fixture, frozen before the first LIVE request. A section 'carries' a concept when every pattern group in `all` matches somewhere in that section's stripped text. Owner = the section designated by argumentUnits to explain it fully. Markers locate candidates; whether a hit is a harmful full re-explanation or a one-sentence back-reference is decided by reading. Markers are NOT widened after outputs are seen; misses are reported alongside manual counts.
